description: Implement FastAPI startup, configuration, database lifecycle, SQLite migrations, health endpoint and focused tests. Respect contract exactly.
Implement synthetic-account login, refresh/logout, session revocation, password hashing and auth tests, strictly matching contract.
Implement /users/me with strict owner isolation and negative authorization tests.
Implement physical-health record persistence, read pagination and schema validation with tests.
Implement wellbeing check-in persistence and read pagination with tests. Do not claim clinical scoring.
Implement authenticated initial profile/history pagination with stable cursor and tests.
Implement upload-only batch sync, stable UUID idempotence, per-item acknowledgements, transactionality and duplicate/conflict/unauthorized tests.
Implement only the approved RiskAlert API and explainable non-diagnostic deterministic rules if specified; otherwise document BLOCKED rule thresholds, never fabricate medical cutoffs.
Add end-to-end synthetic-data API tests, auth isolation, sync replay, errors, and verify the live OpenAPI matches the baseline (semantic compatibility).
Document Docker image, Compose for Ubuntu EC2 with FastAPI loopback exposure, Caddy deployment guidance and tests without touching AWS/cloudflare.
